scope: Sacred Heart parish complex in Tombstone as photographed on 12 March 2015, including the 1881 adobe rectory, 1882 former church and hall, 1947 Mission-style church, and the rose-tree courtyard trellis.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The National Register records the three major construction dates and the 2002 listing.
The 1881 adobe rectory faces Safford Street and has a gabled roof and dormers.

The 1882 gabled hall moved to its current site with an east entrance and later metal roof. The 1947 church uses stuccoed block and corrugated metal with a late 1980s to early 1990s rear addition. The wooden trellis shelters two Lady Banksia rose trees.
